target: Metapad 3.6 Light Edition, official native i386 binary
sourceFindings: Upstream Find/Replace dialogs call CreateMappedBitmap with flags 0 and the default color map
Upstream CreateToolbarEx uses common-control standard small-color assets and adds custom bitmaps
Native FindTextA/ReplaceTextA imports now resolve through shared modeless dialogs; custom templates and subclass forwarding pass separate authored native EXE/DLL acceptance

CreateToolbarEx imports now resolve. Shared standard/custom bitmap strips, TB_CHECKBUTTON/TB_ENABLEBUTTON and native command callbacks pass authored EXE/DLL acceptance; unchanged Metapad execution remains blocked by other imports.

PropertySheetA imports now resolve. Classic modal/modeless native pages, DLL resources, callbacks, Apply/Cancel validation and keyboard navigation pass authored EXE/DLL acceptance. Metapad remains blocked and has not been executed.

GetPrivateProfileStringA/WritePrivateProfileStringA imports now resolve through shared file-backed INI services. Native Unicode EXE/DLL settings, direct ReadFile coherence, exported output and re-uploaded public GUI settings pass browser acceptance. Metapad remains blocked by 11 imports and has not executed.

All 173 static imports resolve after shared HDROP, IsTextUnicode and printerless contracts. Genuine native/browser fixtures verify dropped-file reads and accurate no-printer notices; printing is not available.

Unchanged Metapad executed CRT startup and created its main native window. Its 96-entry accelerator resource exposed an inverted last-entry marker check; the shared parser fix passes a real compiler-generated shortcut resource.

Shared child-window services now allow initially empty framed EDIT controls and restore client edges during resize. Child WS_EX_DLGMODALFRAME and SBARS_SIZEGRIP work; short custom toolbar strips are padded like Wine. Native geometry and actual browser resize acceptance pass.

The pinned unchanged Metapad 3.6 LE executable passes actual Chromium startup without error notices, file-drop loading, text editing, Ctrl+S native filesystem writes, output export, re-upload/command-line reopen and two clean zero exits. Browser x86 compilation takes 0.58-1.08 seconds in this recorded static run.

Shared GetOpenFileNameA/W and GetSaveFileNameA/W now return actual browser selections, import local snapshots and honor native filename buffers/offsets/default extensions and overwrite confirmation. Unchanged Metapad native Open and Save As passes real file creation, overwrite and reopen acceptance in Chromium.

Native custom Find/Replace windows exposed unsupported CB_LIMITTEXT/CB_SETEDITSEL. Shared editable ComboBox limits/selection and browser keyboard routing now pass unchanged Metapad Find Next and Replace All, with two replacements and exact native Ctrl+S output bytes. Chromium macOS Control+H had also been deleting selected text before opening Replace; browser edits for native shortcut chords are prevented.

Classic/extended resource FONT data now creates real HFONTs before initialization, controls use measured dialog units and MapDialogRect matches geometry. Unchanged Metapad four-page Settings passes native validation, Cancel rollback, OK applying six-space indentation and file-backed portable INI export/re-upload persistence. Font-aware tab sizing and native escaped-ampersand presentation also pass.
scope: ANSI editing/drop/save/reopen, standard Open/Save As, bounded Find Next/Replace All and four-page Settings/portable INI acceptance. RichEdit, single Replace, advanced matching, language plugins, font/color pickers, encodings and other commands remain unverified; native file-dialog hooks/templates and legacy multiselect remain incomplete; no installed printers. Executable stays privately cached. Arbitrary Windows compatibility is unproved.
